import csv
from pathlib import Path

source_path = Path("./uploads/sales_q3.csv")
output_path = Path("./my_won_deals_q3.csv")
deal_ids = {"D001", "D003", "D006", "D009"}

if not source_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Source file not found: {source_path.resolve()}")

with source_path.open("r", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as source:
    reader = csv.DictReader(source)
    print("Columns found:", reader.fieldnames)

    rows = [
        {
            "deal_id": row["deal_id"],
            "amount": row["amount"],
        }
        for row in reader
        if row["deal_id"].strip() in deal_ids
        and row["status"].strip().lower() == "won"
    ]

with output_path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as output:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=["deal_id", "amount"])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)

print(f"Saved {len(rows)} won deals to {output_path.resolve()}")
print("Extracted rows:", rows)
